debt_entries.description: select_threshold_on_validation computes a cumulative false-positive curve ignoring score ties. When score distribution has identical values (e.g. ColdStartLocalBaseline constant 1/(n+2)), it selects the tied score as the threshold and reports an artificial validation FPR (~0.001), whereas classifying with score >= threshold marks all tied rows as positive, producing realized FPR 1.0.
debt_entries.impact: Artifact reported achieved_validation_fpr for cold start baseline is misleading; actual validation FPR is 1.0. Does not invalidate realistic conditions with continuous float32 scores, but represents an algorithmic tie-handling defect.
debt_entries.action_required: Do not modify frozen code in this phase. Must be resolved in future protocol version (e.g. Protocol v2.2) by grouping ties before cumulative sum.

debt_entries.description: The artifact fields information_budget.unique_training_rows and training_budget.unique_information_rows contain expanded local-view row counts (e.g. 33,029 for seed 42), not deduplicated unique transaction counts (23,438). The naming suggests unique transaction counting, which led to audit prose confusion.
debt_entries.impact: Semantic confusion between deduplicated transactions and expanded local-view rows across earlier audit phases.
debt_entries.action_required: Do not mutate canonical raw artifact. Must be renamed in future protocol version schema to expanded_local_view_rows and unique_transaction_count.

debt_entries.description: The canonical manifest binds protocol_config_hash, experiment_matrix_hash, generator_source_hash, and feature_schema_hash (LOCAL_ONLY only). It does not hash runner.py, model.py, metrics.py, or the consortium feature schema.
debt_entries.impact: Executable training and evaluation behavior is bound only via git commit SHA (2f64a02b), not independently verifiable from the manifest alone.
debt_entries.action_required: Future manifest specifications should hash all executable runner, model, and metrics modules.
